blocked.install: The Emulation folder cannot be inside PlayOut's install folder: uninstalling or updating PlayOut would delete it. Choose a folder outside it, such as Documents.
blocked.data: The Emulation folder cannot be inside PlayOut's data folder (AppData). Choose a folder outside it, such as Documents.
blocked.insideCurrent: The new place is inside the Emulation folder in use. Choose a folder outside it.
blocked.containsCurrent: The Emulation folder in use is inside the new place. Choose another folder, or one named Emulation.
blocked.notFolder: A file with that name is in the way. Choose another folder.
blocked.currentIsLink: The Emulation folder in use is a link to another folder. Choose the real folder it points to as the Emulation folder first, then move that.
blocked.noSpace: The Emulation folder ({size}) does not fit on that drive ({free} free, and 1 GB is kept free).
blocked.notEmpty: The new place is not empty: choose to move into it or to use it as it is.

busy.game: A game is running. Close it before moving the Emulation folder.
busy.setup: PlayOut is setting up or updating emulators. Move the Emulation folder when it has finished.
busy.convert: A conversion is running. Move the Emulation folder when it has finished.
busy.sending: A paired PC is downloading from the Emulation folder. Move it when the download has finished.
busy.emulator: Close {names} before moving the Emulation folder.
busy.moving: The Emulation folder is being moved. Try again when the move has finished.

alreadyRunning: The Emulation folder is already being moved.
cancelled: Move cancelled. Nothing was moved; the Emulation folder is where it was.
saveFailed: PlayOut could not save the new Emulation folder setting, so nothing was moved. The Emulation folder is where it was.
